name: JobBoardSearch.com
summary: Meta directory of 860+ niche job boards, browsable by industry, location, technology and hiring model.
description: A directory of niche job boards across industries, locations, technologies and work arrangements. Visitors browse and filter hundreds of boards — remote, entry level, design, engineering and many more tags — and each listing links out to the board itself. Job board owners can submit free listings or pay for featured placement; a marketplace handles buying and selling job boards, and free SEO tools support owners.
